blurb: Channel Grove Marina provides dockage for boats up to 35 feet with options for power hookups and guest dockage. They offer boat storage, winterizing, hull maintenance, and a marina store with fishing gear, bait, and fuel. The marina hosts many licensed and insured fishing charter captains for guided fishing trips on Lake Erie.
